title: RFdiffusion2 scaffolds enzyme active sites at atomic level
summary: RFdiffusion2 scaffolded all 41 active sites in a diverse benchmark, compared with 16 for previous methods. Designs were tested experimentally, with fewer than 96 sequences needed per case to find active enzymes across three catalytic mechanisms. The journal abstract's three-mechanism count conflicts with a five-reaction claim in the Institute for Protein Design announcement, so the abstract should be treated as authoritative.
organization: University of Washington Institute for Protein Design (Baker lab)
